name: Cloud Hypervisor
description: KVM-based Rust VMM built on rust-vmm, dual-licensed Apache-2.0 / MIT.
descriptionZh: 基于 rust-vmm 的 KVM Rust VMM，Apache-2.0 / MIT 双许可。
keyFact: Cloud Hypervisor is a KVM-based virtual machine monitor written in Rust on top of the rust-vmm crates, dual-licensed Apache-2.0 OR MIT; it targets cloud workloads with CPU/memory/device hotplug, Windows and Linux guests, and vhost-user device offload, all with a deliberately small attack surface.
keyFactZh: Cloud Hypervisor 是基于 KVM、用 Rust 编写在 rust-vmm crate 之上的虚拟机监控器，采用 Apache-2.0 OR MIT 双许可；它面向云负载，支持 CPU/内存/设备热插拔、Windows 与 Linux guest 以及 vhost-user 设备卸载，并刻意保持极小的攻击面。
